questions.question: • Q1 What happens to oxide thickness when oxidation time increases?

explanations.a: Longer oxidation time generally increases thickness.
explanations.b: Oxide thickness changes with oxidation duration.
explanations.c: Correct! Longer heating time increases oxide growth.
explanations.d: The oxide layer does not disappear during oxidation.

questions.question: • Q2 Which oxidation method generally produces denser and higher-quality oxide layers?

explanations.a: Wet oxidation produces faster growth but comparatively less dense oxide.
explanations.b: Correct! Dry oxidation produces thinner but higher-quality oxide layers.
explanations.c: Steam oxidation is associated with wet oxidation.
explanations.d: Vacuum oxidation is not the standard method used here.

questions.question: • Q3 In the Deal-Grove model, what does X₀ represent?

explanations.a: Temperature is one factor affecting oxidation but not represented by X₀.
explanations.c: Pressure is not represented by X₀ in the Deal-Grove model.
explanations.d: Wafer diameter is unrelated to X₀.

questions.question: • Q4 Which factor does NOT directly affect oxide growth rate?

explanations.b: Longer heating duration increases oxide thickness.
explanations.c: Dry and wet oxidation have different growth rates.
explanations.d: Correct! Wafer color does not affect oxide growth.

questions.question: Q5 What is the primary advantage of wet oxidation compared to dry oxidation?

explanations.a: Dry oxidation generally produces higher-quality oxide.
explanations.b: Correct! Wet oxidation provides a much faster growth rate.
explanations.d: Wet oxidation still requires oxygen and water vapor.

questions.question: Q6 What happens when oxidation temperature is increased?

explanations.a: Correct! Higher temperatures accelerate oxidation reactions.
explanations.b: Oxidation continues and usually becomes faster.

questions.question: Q7 Which output parameter was calculated using the Deal-Grove model in the simulation?

explanations.a: Wafer diameter is not calculated in this experiment.
explanations.b: Correct! The Deal-Grove model estimates oxide thickness.
explanations.c: Quality is derived from process conditions.

questions.question: Q8 What is the function of the silicon dioxide layer formed during oxidation?

answers.c: Serves as a masking layer in fabrication

explanations.c: It can be used as a masking layer.
explanations.d: Correct! Silicon dioxide serves all these purposes.

questions.question: Q9 Why does dry oxidation produce better-quality oxide layers?

answers.a: The oxide is denser and more uniform

explanations.a: Correct! Dry oxidation produces dense and high-quality oxide layers.
explanations.b: Temperature alone is not the reason.

questions.question: Q10 During the simulation, which combination produced the thickest oxide layer?

answers.c: High temperature and long oxidation time

explanations.a: These conditions produce very little oxide growth.
explanations.b: Growth is relatively slower in dry oxidation.
explanations.c: Correct! High temperature and longer oxidation duration result in thicker oxide layers.
